compliancePosture: Aggregate region-level statistics only; no individual sold prices; every figure n>=5. Cite figures verbatim.

angles.headline: 46% of active Ajax listings have cut their asking price
angles.whySurprising: Highest price-cut share of the 15 markets tracked today.

angles.headline: The typical active Whitby listing has now sat 16 days

angles.headline: Brampton is sitting at 0.2 months of supply
angles.whySurprising: Highest months-of-supply of the markets tracked (≈4–6 = balanced; above tilts to buyers).

angles.headline: A 1-bed in Ottawa grosses about 7.1% rental yield
angles.whySurprising: Best gross rental yield of the markets tracked today (1-bed).
